title: View families are categories, not exact camera solutions
plainLanguage: Front, three-quarter, profile, rear three-quarter, and back are useful buckets. They are not exact camera angles, and two poses in the same bucket can still look very different.
purpose: Use simple view families without pretending they solve full 3D geometry.

rules.statement: Treat view family as reviewed categorical evidence, not a solved camera rotation.
Store finer notes or reference relationships when two cases share a family but differ substantially.
Do not infer unseen surfaces solely from a coarse view label.

implementation.currentSupport: Corpus Pane 0.2.2.4 uses an ordered five-step view family for retrieval: FRONT → FRONT_THREE_QUARTER → PROFILE → BACK_THREE_QUARTER → BACK. View distance contributes a graded penalty inside the combined ranking score rather than acting as a hard first sort: a much better neighboring-view shape may outrank a worse same-view shape, while clearly opposing reviewed views are strongly penalized.
implementation.futureWork: Use split body/head labels and region projection state for finer discrimination.
